'''Rikiya Koyama''' (Japanese: '''小山力也''' ''Koyama Rikiya'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Koyama was born on December 18, 1963, in {{wp|Kyoto}}, {{wp|Japan}}. In 1986, he graduated from Ritsumeikan University, and then entered Toho Gakuen College, where he majored in drama. After graduating from Toho Gakuen, Koyama joined the Haiyuza Theatre Company, a {{wp|Tokyo}}-based theatre company, in 1988. During his time there, Koyama became publicly noticed for his performances in several plays. He eventually started getting roles in Japanese TV shows and anime. In the {{pkmn|animated series}}, Koyama initially voiced [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] during {{aniseries|OS}} and {{aniseries|DP}}. He then voiced [[Kagetomo]], a recurring character in {{aniseries|XY}}. In addition, he voiced [[Giovanni]], the [[Team Rocket]] leader; and [[Archie]], the [[Team Aqua]] leader; they appeared in [[Pokémon Origins]] and [[Pokémon Generations]], respectively.
